title: Serializable cross-shard transaction protocol
narrative: As a developer, I want multi-node, multi-shard transactions that are atomic and serializable so that graph updates are never partially applied.

evals.name: jepsen serializability (Elle)
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- jepsen --workload list-append --nemesis partition,crash,clock,membership,split --duration 1h --check serializable
